description: Aleksander Chernyavskiy and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. The public JSON file contains GPS/GNSS and IMU recordings from a Seafar vessel navigation. Field definitions cover heading, position, speed over ground, turn rate, roll/pitch/yaw and acceleration; acceleration is described as gravity-compensated. Coverage is one source-described navigation recording, with route, duration and sample interval unspecified. The same provider has a later restricted deposit whose trial independence cannot be established, so it remains held. Saved descriptive metadata contained numeric examples; only their field names and units are used here. Zenodo supplies the deposited data and native file inventory with open access under cc-by-4.0. The full saved native description included illustrative numeric observations; no linked file body was read, and those values are omitted here. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations. A more specific simulation use is not established by the brief source description.
